## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Date of Agreement:** September 30, 2022

**Transaction Description:** Amendment No. 1 to an existing Credit Agreement originally dated October 28, 2020. The amendment involves multiple lenders with Bank of America, N.A. serving as Administrative Agent. Other participating lenders include MUFG Bank Ltd., Truist Bank, Barclays Bank PLC, Citibank N.A., Goldman Sachs Bank USA, Morgan Stanley Bank N.A., and U.S. Bank National Association.

**Purpose of Financing:** The amendment facilitates Atlassian's announced exploration of redomiciliation from England and Wales to the United States. The redomiciliation involves inserting Atlassian Corporation (a Delaware corporation) as the new parent holding company through a court-approved scheme of arrangement under Part 26 of the UK Companies Act 2006.

**Company Background:** Atlassian operates as part of a technology group with global operations. The company maintains SEC reporting obligations and operates with consolidated subsidiaries across multiple jurisdictions.
